argv:
import csv,json,re,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
records=[json.loads(line) for line in Path(".experiment/commands.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()]
for record in records:
    assert record["cwd"]==str(Path.cwd()),record
    assert Path(record["stdout_stderr_path"]).is_file(),record
rows=list(csv.DictReader(Path(".experiment/decisions.tsv").open(),delimiter="\t"))
for row in rows:
    assert Path(row["evidence"]).is_file(),row
print("All",len(rows),"decision pointers resolve and",len(records),"command outputs exist inside assigned root.")
print("Preserved execution summaries")
for record in records:
    if not record["label"].startswith("review-"):
        print(record["ts"],record["label"],"exit",record["exit_code"],record["stdout_stderr_path"])
initial=subprocess.check_output(["git","show","610a9c32f864a0ef6ce66d0ea0e40cb904f1ab24:relayboard/service.py"],text=True)
current=Path("relayboard/service.py").read_text()
old='        if attempt.number < job.max_attempts:\n            self._emit_failure_alert(run_id)\n            return "retry"'
new='        if attempt.number < job.max_attempts:\n            return "retry"'
assert initial.count(old)==1
assert current==initial.replace(old,new)
print("Production service is exactly initial source minus retry-branch emission.")
for p in [".experiment/outputs/implementation-focused-before.txt",".experiment/outputs/implementation-focused-after.txt",".experiment/outputs/implementation-full-public.txt"]:
    lines=Path(p).read_text().splitlines()
    print(p)
    print("\n".join(lines[-5:]))
print("Failure output successful-retry excerpt")
lines=Path(".experiment/outputs/implementation-focused-before.txt").read_text().splitlines()
start=next(i for i,line in enumerate(lines) if line.startswith("FAIL: test_successful_retry"))
print("\n".join(lines[start:start+45]))
print("No full-suite rerun. Preserved pass outputs and unchanged reviewed code justify no additional runtime check.")
